{{Top}}
'''Blumfruit juice''' was a sticky and sweet beverage made from [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]] berries. As a child, [[Vima Sunrider]] drank blumfruit juice, which she tended to get all over her face and clothing.

*[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]
